unsafe_justifications.justification: The validator receives the complete original payload. Original bytes, proof payload and decoded lengths, profile fingerprint, decoded arena budget, exact slot count and kinds, and checked raw spans are verified before publication. Independent strict traversal through EOF validates the complete wrapper and snapshot, binds each asserted slot to its wire value or absolute book span, and validates every book level using the existing depth helper and supplied decimal policies. Original validator payload, decoded arena and proof move intact into the message. SnapshotValues emits no StrRef and owns every Decimal128 book value, retaining no cursor, scratch or inner-payload reference.

Only the test validator issues proofs. Strict extraction and semantic inspection complete successfully before proof issuance, checked conversions establish exact buffer lengths, the cursor validates decoded strings, and the same payload, decoded arena and slots are returned under the frozen snapshot/profile fingerprint. Production code never issues a proof.
